title: Periyar 2018 flood: open-data D-Flow FM model, sensitivity and uncertainty workflow (research code and results)
description: Research code, per-run results and manuscript sources for the article "How far can one gauge mark and one radar image narrow parameter uncertainty in an open-data flood model? Sensitivity analysis of the 2018 Periyar flood". Version v1.1-periyar corrects an 840 m geolocation error of the Sentinel-1 radar flood map used in v1.0, rebuilds the map with the unchanged v1.0 rules and rescores every run against the corrected map; no threshold, acceptance rule, tolerance, factor range, seed or model was changed. v1.0-periyar remains available as the record before the correction. The archive is a snapshot of the GitHub fork karthice1/HYDROLIB-core at tag v1.1-periyar, plus the clean-environment test report of that exact commit. Licensing (see NOTICE): HYDROLIB-core 1.5.0, copyright Deltares, MIT (LICENSE), included unchanged; the research code in research/gsa and research/periyar, copyright Karthik V and Roopa D, MIT (research/LICENSE); the manuscript source in research/periyar/manuscript (the v1.0 manuscript) is not MIT-licensed. python -m research.periyar.check_results_v11 checks 658 corrected-map values and python -m research.periyar.check_results the 120 v1.0 values, both from the stored results without running D-Flow FM. See README_FIRST.md, research/periyar/RELEASE_NOTES_v11.md and research/periyar/REPRODUCE_v11.md.
